article_summaries.title: Summer Camp - Pirates Week
article_summaries.summary: Official freerealms.com news post for the Summer Camp event's Pirates Week theme. It describes a themed week with pirate-costume dressing, a member-only Pirates Plunder game, a Seaside pier NPC, and the expected schedule of in-game community events and TCG events, plus how players used the in-game Game Guide calendar to teleport to events.

article_summaries.title: Summer Camp - Lakeshore Fun Week
article_summaries.summary: Freerealms.com news post for the Summer Camp community event series, this week's theme 'Lakeshore Fun Week'. It describes Lakeshore as a lake area with the Durango Zoo and Robgoblins nearby, lists expected in-game event times, and explains how to use the Game Guide calendar and GO button to teleport to events. The post gives only a relative posting time ('4 days, 22 hours ago') so the exact date is unknown.
